_izoh: Har bir qator — bitta tarif. tariff_usd_kg yoki tariff_uzs_kg dan biri (0 — hali kiritilmagan). white_docs/olmaliq: true, false yoki null (noma'lum). vol_divisor: hajmiy vazn bo'luvchisi. series_ok: bir xil tovar partiyasini (3+ dona) qabul qiladimi. min_kg: minimal yuk vazni. Yangilagach botga /import_kargo yozing (yoki ilovada 🚚 Kargo → 📥).

cargos.name: Mandarin
cargos.note: Standart tovar. To'lov kelganda. Xitoyda 7 kun tekin saqlash. Ofis: Toshkent, Chilonzor, Arnasoy 5A.

cargos.name: Mandarin seriya
cargos.note: 3 tadan ortiq bir xil tovar, batareyali elektronika, kosmetika. Partiyalar shu tarifda!

cargos.name: MK Express avto
cargos.note: 100 kg dan 78 000 so'm/kg. 30+ filial. Olmaliq filiali MK037 (Oydin bekati orqasi, uyga yetkazish), +998880279515.

cargos.name: MK Express 100kg+
cargos.note: Faqat 100 kg dan katta yuk uchun. Olmaliq filiali MK037 (Oydin bekati orqasi, uyga yetkazish), +998880279515.

cargos.name: MK Express avia
cargos.note: Oddiy mahsulot. Brend 156 000 so'm/kg. Aviada seriya OLINMAYDI — partiya uchun avto kargo. Olmaliq filiali MK037, +998880279515.

cargos.name: MK Express avto pochta
cargos.note: Pochta yo'nalishi: seriya (bir xil tovar partiyasi) OLINMAYDI. Brend 6.99 $/kg. Olmaliq filiali MK037, +998880279515.

cargos.name: iPost avto
cargos.note: TARIFNI KIRITING: saytdagi kalkulyatordan. 800+ punkt, 14 hudud, bojxona deklaratsiyasi.

cargos.name: Sellmate standart
cargos.note: Eng arzon, lekin 30 kun. Bayer 3% (min xarid $3000).

cargos.name: Meest avia
cargos.note: Reys: seshanba, juma. Sug'urta $100 gacha tekin, $100-500: ortiqcha qismning 2.5%. Hajmiy vazn 2x dan katta bo'lsa yarmi olinadi. Tijorat avto 30kg+ bojxona bilan — narxini so'rang.

cargos.name: Green Post avia
cargos.note: Faqat standart tovar. Reys: seshanba, juma.

cargos.name: Green Post avto pochta
cargos.note: Batareya, suyuqlik, kukun ham. Jo'natish: shanba.

cargos.name: Green Post Cargo Commerce
cargos.note: Tijorat yuklari. Batareya/suyuqlik/kukun +$2/kg. Qadoqlash $0.4/kg, konsolidatsiya $0.2/kg, tekshiruv $0.5/kg.

cargos.name: Jana Post
cargos.note: $0.61/100 g, 100 g gacha yaxlitlanadi. Namunalar uchun. Toshkentda 5 punkt. Muddatni so'rang.

cargos.name: Yumecs tijorat
cargos.note: Xitoy oddiy $8.5-10/kg; 3+ bir xil tovar $12 dan. Batareya +$20, atir +$9.99. 14 kun tekin saqlash.

cargos.name: Transit Pro
cargos.note: $3-6/kg bojxona rasmiylashtiruvi bilan (yuqori chegara olindi). YATT tijorat yuklari 10kg+. Bayer 10%. Toshkentda 3 kundan keyin 500 so'm/kg/kun.

cargos.name: Tez Kargo Olmaliq
cargos.note: TEKSHIRILMAGAN (katalog). Metallurglar ko'ch. 5, dehqon bozori yonida. Tarif, hujjat va sug'urtani telefon orqali aniqlang.
